metadata.title: checkGM healthy-adult gut metagenome baselines (assembly v0.8, read v0.2) and pipeline container
metadata.description:
Healthy-adult reference baselines and the pinned pipeline container for checkGM, which reports every taxon, gene family and pathway of a gut metagenome as a percentile among healthy adults processed the same way.

Baselines. Each bundle holds summary statistics only — per-feature prevalence by sequencing-depth class, 1st–99th percentiles among carriers, and the normalization rules — and contains no sample-level data. The assembly baseline (v0.8) is built from 1,941 healthy adults in 26 MGnify v5 studies; the read baseline (v0.2) from 6,494 healthy adults in 19 curatedMetagenomicData 3 studies. Two inclusion tiers are provided. Both require a healthy or control label and exclude samples labelled diseased or under treatment; the strict tier additionally requires that the health label be present rather than merely uncontradicted and, wherever the field is recorded, that the donor be aged 18–65, have a body-mass index of 18.5–30, not be pregnant and report no recent antibiotics. The lenient tier is the one used in the paper and the one deposited here (1,941 and 6,494 adults); the strict tier (1,588 and 6,235), used only for sensitivity analysis, is not deposited but is rebuilt deterministically from the archived configuration by the build script in the repository.

Container. checkgm_assembly.sif is an Apptainer image pinning the assembly-based pipeline (metaSPAdes 3.15.3 / MEGAHIT 1.2.9, Prodigal 2.6.3, FragGeneScan, DIAMOND against UniRef90, eggNOG-mapper, KOfam, InterProScan) so that new samples are placed on exactly the scale the baseline was built on. The read-based pipeline is built from the recipe in the repository rather than shipped as an image.

Verification. RELEASE.json records the SHA-256 of every tarball together with a round-trip check in which 40 query samples were re-scored from the packaged bundle and compared against the originals.

Software, documentation and container recipes: https://github.com/khoa-yelo/Meta2 (branch checkgm, subdirectory checkgm).
